les.title: 🏋 Sparring: develop aur castle
yaad: Knights pehle, phir bishops, phir castle.

steps.md:
Ab principles **engine ke against**. Engine kamzor level par khelta hai, par tumhari galti ka fayda uthayega.

Goal: 12 chaal mein **4 chhote pieces bahar + castle**, bina material khoye.

Practice ke baad test: 5 naye positions, **4/5**.

steps.q: Opening sparring: **12 chaal** mein saare 4 chhote pieces (knights, bishops) bahar lao aur **castle** karo. Material mat khona!

les.title: 🏋 Sparring: fayda bachao (middlegame)
les.sub: Aage wali position engine ke against khelo
yaad: Aage ho: pehle safety, phir forcing chaalein.
Pieces trade karo jab aage ho.

steps.md:
Asli games ki middlegame positions jahan tum **aage** ho. Engine (medium level) wapas aane ki koshish karega.

Goal: 12 chaal ke baad Stockfish ka number **+1.5** ya zyada (tumhari taraf se).

Test: 5 positions, **4/5**.

steps.why: Aage ho to: pehle apni safety (hanging pieces), phir forcing chaalein (check, capture, threat), aur pieces trade karo.

les.title: 🏋 Sparring: plan banao aur chalao
les.sub: Barabar middlegame, strong engine ke against
yaad: Kamzor point dhundo, bura piece behtar karo.
Plan badlo sirf jab position badle.

steps.md:
Barabar middlegame positions. Pehle position padho (elements), **plan** chuno, phir 15 chaal khelo. Engine kaafi strong level par hai.

Goal: end mein engine ka number **−0.3** se behtar.

Test: 5 positions, **4/5**.

steps.why: Plan: pehle sabse kamzor dushman point dhundo, phir apna sabse bura piece behtar karo.

yaad: Aage ho to pieces trade karo, pawns nahi.

Goal: end mein **+2** ya jeet.

les.title: 🏋 Sparring: GM level (full engine)
les.sub: Barabar position, engine poori taakat se
yaad: Practical: simple aur safe chaalein jab confuse ho.

steps.md:
Sabse mushkil sparring: Stockfish **poori taakat** se. Barabar position, 20 chaal, balance mat khona.

Goal: end mein engine ka number **−0.3** se behtar.

Test: 5 positions, **4/5**.

steps.q: GM sparring: barabar position, engine **poori taakat** se. **20 chaal** khelo aur balance mat khona (end mein **−0.3** se behtar).
